name: Discover Responsiveness & Metadata Cache Efficiency
changes: Returns persisted Discover title detail immediately with stale-while-revalidate instead of blocking on a slow metadata-cloud refresh when usable cached detail already exists.

Keeps metadata-cache.json parsed in a signature-aware process-local cache, revalidates before writes for desktop/service coexistence, and writes compact JSON to reduce multi-megabyte parse/write amplification.
Bounds Discover detail refreshes to two concurrent background tasks and reduces true cold detail network budget from 18 seconds to 8 seconds.
Separates hover prefetch from explicit title views so prefetch never changes For You viewed-history feedback.
Adds Discover route/cache/detail performance telemetry to diagnostics without changing Metadata Server v0.3.3 or private SABnzbd 5.1.2 behavior.
Preserves v3.6.58 Automation runtime reconciliation, orphan pruning, semantic state precedence and all established download/import protections.
regression_guards: Repeated metadata-cache reads reuse the parsed in-memory snapshot; an external file change is reloaded before a local write so peer-process entries are preserved.
Metadata-cache writes are compact and retain the existing 500-entry/400-entry trim policy.
Stale persisted Discover detail returns immediately and schedules bounded background refresh; a true cold detail request uses an 8-second cloud budget.
Hover prefetch requests do not record a viewed-history event, while explicit opens do.
Discover diagnostics expose Home/Browse/Detail route percentiles plus metadata-cache and detail-refresh counters.
All v3.6.58 and earlier regression guards remain mandatory; SAB transfer/repair/extraction architecture is unchanged.
